title: clear-pii-flag command payload

decidedBy.description: The deciding admin's oid, written to Documents.PiiClearedBy.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command clear-pii-flag (processing design §9.5): records the clearance on the document (Documents.PiiClearedAt, PiiClearedBy, PiiClearedCounts = the held set's PiiCounts) and releases its held set without re-processing. Dedup pii-clear:{documentId}.
